article.title: Will may be revoked or altered.
article.content: A will is liable to be revoked or altered by the maker of it at any time when he is competent to dispose of his property by will.
article.html:
62Will may be revoked or altered.

Section 62 · Part VI · Chapter II · page 29 of the Act

A will is liable to be revoked or altered by the maker of it at any time when he is competent to dispose of his property by will.
